Now I need to carefully migrate `health.ts`. The existing `healthRoutes` function signature must remain identical — same parameters, same return type (Express `Router`). The route is mounted at `/health` under the `/api` prefix (app.ts:183), so the internal handler path stays `"/"`.

The health handler is complex — it reads `req.actor`, `req.get(...)`, and uses `db` and config options. I'll extract the core logic into `Handler`-typed functions and wire them back to Express via `expressHandler`. The tricky parts:
- `req.get("x-paperclip-dev-server-status-token")` — must come from `ctx.headers`
- `req.actor?.type` — comes from `ctx.actor`
- No `db` in the handler constructor path (when `db` is undefined) — `ctx.db` will always be present since deps requires it; I'll handle the optional db via closure from `opts`

Since `RequestCtx` always has `db` but the health route accepts `db?: Db` (optional), I need to handle this carefully. I'll keep the optional db in the outer closure and only use `ctx.db` when db is defined. The handler receives deps but the route factory already closes over `db` from its own argument.
